items.title: BIS Paper Shows Meme-Level Grasp of Bitcoin, But Agrees With Saylor on Key Point
items.summary: A paper from the Bank for International Settlements (BIS), an organization of central banks, recycles old, repeatedly rebutted claims about bitcoin–but agrees with Strategy's Michael Saylor that it isn't working as everyday money. items.title: Bitcoin Hits Weekly High as Crypto Market Rebounds
items.summary: Bitcoin is back near $84,500 as XRP and Zcash lead a broad crypto rebound from October's slide, putting "Uptober" back on the table.

items.title: Beyond HODLing: How Bitcoin-Backed Loans Can Unlock New Financial Opportunities
items.summary: SALT Lending highlights how Bitcoin holders can access liquidity for real estate, business expansion, and other financial opportunities without selling their Bitcoin. This post Beyond HODLing: How Bitcoin-Backed Loans Can Unlock New Financial Opportunities first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Josh Plischke .

items.title: Musk's SpaceX-Tesla Merger Would Create a Bitcoin Treasury Behemoth
items.summary: Musk said both boards formed committees to weigh a tie-up that would combine Tesla's 11,509 BTC and SpaceX's 18,712 BTC–roughly $2.5 billion worth–onto a single balance sheet.

items.title: Kalshi Pushes Deeper Into Crypto Derivatives With Bitcoin-Backed Margin Loans
items.summary: A new tri-party lending structure with BitGo lets Kalshi Prime clients borrow against bitcoin to margin perpetual futures. This post Kalshi Pushes Deeper Into Crypto Derivatives With Bitcoin-Backed Margin Loans first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin Nears $85,000 as SpaceX Earnings Reignite Risk Appetite
items.summary: The price of bitcoin is rising fast – with the stock market – as investors feel bullish on tech. This post Bitcoin Nears $85,000 as SpaceX Earnings Reignite Risk Appetite first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
